summary: Frontend-only testing of two new KosManager features (A) Finance filter + (B) Backup includes KTP photos. CORE FILTER FEATURES VERIFIED WORKING END-TO-END ON WEB PREVIEW: (1) Kamar A1 chip filter on Pemasukan — filter button label becomes 'Filter (1)', finance-filter-note visible, finance-chip-room shown, summary label switches to 'Hasil Filter', income derived from filtered list (Rp 1.000.000 = T1 only; pemasukan lain hidden). Removing chip restores full-month view and finance-chip-room disappears. (2) Penghuni T2 filter in Oct period correctly renders EmptyState 'Tidak ada transaksi yang cocok' with 'Reset Filter' action (testID finance-empty-masuk + finance-empty-masuk-action), text matches spec. Seed data: 2 rooms (A1 1.000.000, B2 800.000), 2 tenants (T1→A1, T2→B2), T1 payment pay_date=2026-10-09, T2 payment pay_date=2026-09-19, pengeluaran Listrik 150.000 today, pemasukan lain 200.000 20d ago — all created successfully via UI. Oct Pemasukan Rp 1.000.000, Pengeluaran Rp 150.000 (Saldo Rp 850.000) matches expectation (T2/pemasukan-lain correctly excluded as they are in Sep). Code review of FinanceFilterSheet and finance.tsx confirms correct implementation of countFilters, hasRange, rangeLabel, finance-range / finance-range-label / finance-range-clear, filter-preset-7/30/lastmonth, filter-from/to with YYYY-MM-DD validation (error strings 'Isi kedua tanggal...' and 'Tanggal awal harus sebelum tanggal akhir'), and tab-aware showParties gating (only on masuk). Rekap tab correctly omits finance-filter-button and keeps finance-month. Code review of src/share.ts attachKtpPhotos + restoreKtpPhotos and settings.tsx doExport/doImport confirms: exportAll produces version:2 with photos:{}; attachKtpPhotos reads data:image/jpeg;base64 or expo-file-system base64 into photos map; toast template literal correctly includes 'N foto KTP'; confirm dialog message includes 'N foto KTP' via Object.keys(obj.photos ?? {}).length — handles v1 (no photos field) safely. restoreKtpPhotos writes data: URI on web, matching tenant-ktp-image rendering. Download-based verification of exported JSON v2 structure and full file-chooser import flow for v1/v2 payloads were WRITTEN as part of the test script but not fully executed in this iteration because the Playwright click for filter-preset-7 fell outside the mobile viewport inside the bottom sheet; test aborted after T2.

issues: On 390x844 mobile viewport the Rentang tanggal preset buttons (filter-preset-7/30/lastmonth) and from/to fields render below the fold inside the sheet when 'Kamar' + 'Penghuni' chip sections are present. Users must scroll the inner ScrollView to reach them. Consider lifting Rentang tanggal above the parties section OR increasing maxHeight (currently 460) OR auto-scrolling to presets when sheet opens, especially since the date range is the primary new feature.

action_items: No functional bugs confirmed in features A (filter) or B (backup) via code review and partial E2E. Please main agent run the remaining filter preset / validation / backup-export-download / import-v1-v2 flows (script was constructed but hit viewport scroll issue inside the sheet — not a product bug but worth noting UX).
Consider reordering FinanceFilterSheet so Rentang tanggal (date range) section appears before Kamar/Penghuni on Pemasukan tab, so presets are reachable without scrolling on small viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: src/db/repo.ts listFinance: range.to defaults to `${period}-31` which is a lexicographic max; works because pay_date is YYYY-MM-DD, but technically dates like 2026-02-31 don't exist — BETWEEN still correct via string compare. OK but subtle.

src/components/FinanceFilterSheet.tsx apply(): if only one of from/to is provided (f || t) and the other is empty, validation fails with 'Isi kedua tanggal' — matches spec. Reset button bypasses validation by calling onApply({}) directly — good.

src/share.ts attachKtpPhotos: when t.ktp_photo starts with 'data:' it stores base64 after comma — correct. On web, non-data URIs are silently skipped (since no FileSystem reads) — this is fine because web only stores data: URIs via persistKtpPhoto.
settings.tsx doImport: Object.keys(obj.photos ?? {}).length used before validateBackup check in current code order — actually it's AFTER validateBackup (line 48). Good.

exportAll() returns version:2 but does NOT include photos key itself (that's attached in attachKtpPhotos). Downstream doExport correctly chains them. v1 backups re-exported from this app will always become v2 — ok, backwards-compatible one-way migration.

success_rate.frontend: Partial — T1 Kamar filter + T1 remove + T2 Penghuni empty-state fully verified. T3 (date range presets), T4 (validation), T5 (keluar/rekap gating), T6 (PDF regression), T7-T9 (backup export+import v1/v2) require re-run with scroll fix. Seed CRUD (rooms/tenants/payments/cash) all passed.

seed_data_creation: Created in sql.js in-memory DB: Room A1 (price 1.000.000, id=1), Room B2 (price 800.000, id=2); Tenant T1 (id=1, room A1, entry 2026-07-01), Tenant T2 (id=2, room B2, entry 2026-07-01); Payment T1 pay_date 2026-10-09 Rp 1.000.000 (period 2026-10), Payment T2 pay_date 2026-09-19 Rp 800.000 (period 2026-09); Pengeluaran Listrik 150.000 dated 2026-10-09; Pemasukan lain 200.000 dated 2026-09-19.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Container date is 2026-10-09. sql.js is in-memory per browser session — seed every run. The FinanceFilterSheet bottom-sheet inner ScrollView has maxHeight 460; on 390x844 viewport the Rentang tanggal preset buttons sit below the fold when parties chips are rendered on Pemasukan tab. Use locator.scroll_into_view_if_needed() for filter-preset-7/30/lastmonth and filter-from/to BEFORE click/fill — do NOT just rely on force=True. Receipt route hides the (tabs) bar — use page.goto('/tenants') or '/finance' to navigate after payment save rather than clicking tab-* which is not rendered. On tenant form the room chip label is 'Kmr A1' (not 'Kamar A1'); use testID tenant-room-<roomId> directly. Toast overlay briefly intercepts tab bar taps — wait for toast-message to disappear (polling query_selector) before next tab click. For backup export+import on web: use page.expect_download for shareBackup() which triggers a blob download (filename kosmanager-backup-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.json). For import use page.expect_file_chooser then set_files on the file path — expo-document-picker on web opens a native file picker.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs reproduced. Only a mobile-viewport UX note about preset buttons sitting below the fold inside the filter sheet (users and tests must scroll the sheet).
